title: Implement a reversible claim-dossier model
objective: Implement a deliberately application-level, reversible dossier format sufficient to represent one How We Know vertical slice with source works, editions, exact spans, propositions, assertions, evidence relations, dependence, and claim families without prematurely declaring a stable protocol ontology.
required_evaluation: strict dossier validation and content-addressing tests
acceptance: source work identity is distinct from the exact edition or snapshot examined
every represented source span names its edition, locator, exact quoted or structured extent, and digest
propositions are distinct from actor assertions and policy-relative evaluations
support, rebuttal, qualification, undercutting, replication, and dependence remain representable
unknown lineage is explicit and earns no automatic independence credit
no dossier object contains an intrinsic global truth or confidence field
invalid spans, dangling relations, duplicate stable IDs, and malformed dependence references fail closed
HTML, Markdown, JSON, API, MCP, and CLI adapters can consume one disclosure-safe dossier identity
make check passes without changing accepted source state
limitations: The dossier format is an alpha application contract, not an accepted replacement for the normative event envelope or a universal ontology.
Promotion into schemas or protocol guarantees requires a later protocol-normative task with independent evaluation and compatibility analysis.
This task provides validated structure and fixtures; it does not admit public empirical or philosophical conclusions.
